question_text: The Foreign Exchange Management Act replaced which earlier law?

options.A: Companies Act 1956 — incorrect: not the statute repealed by FEMA section 49.
options.B: Foreign Exchange Regulation Act 1973 — correct: FEMA section 49(1) expressly repeals Act 46 of 1973.
options.C: Competition Act 2002 — incorrect: distinct competition legislation, enacted after FEMA 1999.
options.D: RBI Act 1934 — incorrect: RBI continues under its separate foundational legislation.

sources.claim: Official Department of Revenue confirms replacement and commencement 1 June 2000
